answer: Cap pay per network origin. Each epoch, answers are grouped by the autonomous system and /24 address block they came from, and every block shares one reward slice no bigger than a single honest agent earns. A farm of 300 fakes on one rented terrace of servers drains into a single river of pay, worth one account. To scale, the attacker must lease addresses from hundreds of separate providers, each its own knoll of the internet, paying hosting per identity and risking that shared billing links them.
